svg.title: A backup precedes the test control
svg.desc: Place the backup before the test control in reading order. Keep the run abstract; preparation communicates anticipated risk without inventing emotion. Visual distinction: A ratchet edge and an unpressed control identify a one-way action. No crossing arrow or activated state establishes an outcome.
